raises: InternalRegistrationError when candidate is tagged as internal

dependents.notes: Used by internal components to tag and block registration of kernel/control-plane objects.

integration_flow: Block if sentinel tag is present

usage_snippets.code:
from melder.__melder_registration_guard__ import __melder_registration_guard__ as guard
class InternalThing:
    __melder_internal__ = guard.sentinel

guard.assert_allowed(InternalThing, context="bind")
usage_snippets.title: Tag and block internal registration

lifecycle.construction: Singleton instance created on first access and cached process-wide.
lifecycle.ownership: Owns a single sentinel object; no external resources.

invariants: Guard does not perform deep inspection
pitfalls: Forgetting to tag internal objects with the sentinel
Comparing sentinel by value instead of identity
responsibilities: Provide a sentinel tag for internal Melder objects
Block registration attempts for tagged objects

summary.detail: Singleton guard that uses a sentinel tag to prevent Melder internal objects from being registered as spells.
summary.one_liner: Sentinel-based guard that blocks internal registration.
